license_required.quote: Any person who practices or attempts to practice podiatry in this state, without being licensed by and registered with the board

issuing_authority.value: Rhode Island Department of Health / Director of Health
issuing_authority.quote: To issue, pursuant to any rules and regulations promulgated by the board and approved by the director, all licenses and registrations required by this chapter to duly qualified applicants

age_minimum.quote: satisfactory proof that the applicant is more than eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.quote: the applicant shall provide evidence that the degree doctor of podiatric medicine was conferred upon the applicant from the same college as was his or her course of study

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: evidence of satisfactory completion of a course of study in podiatric medicine approved and accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

required.quote: the applicant shall provide evidence of satisfactory completion of a minimum one-year residency program as defined, recognized, and accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

duration.quote: satisfactory completion of a minimum one-year residency program

kind.quote: a minimum one-year residency program as defined, recognized, and accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

exams.name: Theoretical examination
exams.notes: Must be passed before practical examination
exams.quote: All applicants are required to take an examination with respect to theory as well as a practical examination.

exams.name: Practical examination
exams.notes: Cannot be taken until theoretical examination is passed and residency is completed
exams.quote: no applicant is permitted to take the practical examination until he or she has satisfactorily passed the theoretical examination and has completed his or her residency

interval_years.quote: All licenses to practice podiatry shall be renewed biennially on the date of expiration.

required.quote: The application shall be accompanied or supported by evidence of the completion of a minimum of fifteen (15) continuing medical education credits per year as approved by the board of examiners in podiatry.

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of fifteen (15) continuing medical education credits per year

period_years.quote: a minimum of fifteen (15) continuing medical education credits per year

available.quote: There shall be no reciprocity in granting licenses for the practice of podiatric medicine and surgery (podiatry) to licensees from other states or countries.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who practices or attempts to practice podiatry in this state, without being licensed by and registered with the board

title_protection.quote: any person who uses the title "podiatrist" or any word or title to induce the belief that he or she is engaged in the practice of podiatry, without complying with the provisions of this chapter, shall upon the first conviction be punished

scope_protection.quote: Any person except a licensed podiatrist, a licensed osteopathic physician, or a physician, licensed to practice medicine or surgery, who practices or attempts to practice podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license or limited registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license of limited registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising of podiatry business intended or tending to deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of podiatry business that is intended or has a tendency to deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or a crime arising out of the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, or conviction of a crime arising out of the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dependence on controlled substances, habitual drunkenness, or rendering services while intoxicated or incapacitated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dependence upon a controlled substance, habitual drunkenness, or rendering professional services to a patient while the podiatrist or limited registrant is intoxicated or incapacitated by the use of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting sale of drugs, devices, or services in a manner that exploits the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion by a podiatrist or limited registrant of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods or services provided for a patient in a manner that exploits the patient for the financial gain of the podiatrist or limited registrant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct of a podiatrist or limited registrant in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish patient medical record details to a succeeding podiatrist or medical facility upon proper request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish details of a patient's medical record to a succeeding podiatrist or medical facility upon proper request pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for referring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful misrepresentation in treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry with an unlicensed podiatrist or aiding unlicensed persons in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing podiatry with an unlicensed podiatrist except in accordance with the rules and regulations of the board, or aiding or abetting those unlicensed persons in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services or filing false statements for collection of fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional or mental incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional or mental incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of podiatry, including departure from minimal standards of acceptable practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of podiatry that includes the rendering of unnecessary podiatry services and any departure from or the failure to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing podiatry practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action against a license in another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, surrender, or limitation of privilege based on quality of care provided or any other disciplinary action against a license to practice podiatry in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a medical liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board or its representatives with legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its director, investigator, or representative information legally requested by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provisions of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provisions of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board or any rules and regulations promulgated by the director

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain standards established by peer-review boards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain standards established by peer-review boards, including but not limited to, standards related to proper utilization of services, and use of nonaccepted procedure or quality of care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging personal injury claimants amounts in excess of insurer reimbursement as a condition of providing services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A podiatrist providing services to a person who is making a claim as a result of a personal injury, who charges or collects from the person any amount in excess of the reimbursement to the podiatrist by the insurer as a condition of providing or continuing to provide services or treatment

definition_quote.value: Any person is practicing podiatry within the meaning of this chapter who uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise, for their own self or for any other person, in connection with their own name, the word "podiatrist" or "podiatric physician and surgeon," or the title DPM, or any other words, letters, titles, or descriptive matter, personal or not, that directly or indirectly implies the practice of podiatry
definition_quote.quote: Any person is practicing podiatry within the meaning of this chapter who uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise, for their own self or for any other person, in connection with their own name, the word "podiatrist" or "podiatric physician and surgeon," or the title DPM

methods_authorized.quote: to diagnose or profess to diagnose, or to treat or profess to treat, or to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe for conditions of the pedal extremity; selling or giving substances containing alcohol or narcotic drugs for other than legal purposes is prohibited
drug_authority.quote: to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The foot is defined to be the pedal extremity of the human body and its articulations, and shall include the tendons and muscles of the lower leg only as they are involved in the condition of the foot.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: "Podiatrist," a person licensed as described in this chapter, shall be considered a physician and surgeon of the foot and ankle.

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: For the purposes of reimbursement by and for subscriber benefits/participation agreements with health maintenance organizations, nonprofit medical-service corporations, for-profit medical service corporations, and third-party insurers, it is unlawful to discriminate against podiatrists.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter is construed to prohibit the fitting, recommending, or sale of orthopedic shoes by retail dealers or manufacturers
